in_hebrew.name: מאוריציו
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Maurizio is a name derived from the Hebrew language, which means 'God of the sea'. This name is not directly mentioned in the Bible, but it can be traced back to the root 'Maur' which is found in the Hebrew Bible in the name 'Mor', meaning 'sea'.

in_greek.name: Μαύριος
in_greek.long_meaning: Maurizio is a name of Greek origin, which means 'Dark'. In the New Testament, there is a saint named Maurus, who is also known as Maurizio. He is a martyr, one of the Seven Sleepers of Ephesus.

in_latin.name: Mauritius
in_latin.long_meaning: Maurizio is a name of Latin origin, which translates to 'Maurice' or 'Sea-born'. In the Roman Catholic Church, there is a saint named Mauritius, who is also known as Saint Maurice of Thebes. He is the patron saint of soldiers, Switzerland, and Moorish people.
